entities.summary: Liao, a notable figure in the history of Mongolia, associated with Uyghur and Khitan Empires (907–1125). Preceded by Khitan Liao Dynasty and Uyghurs help Tang China suppress the An Lushan Rebellion. Their legacy influenced Temüjin proclaimed Genghis Khan ('Universal Ruler') at the kurultai.
